settings.title: Integrity
settings.text: Every ingredient is carefully chosen, based on a clear understanding of its purpose. Precise, intentional dosing ensures that every ingredient has a defined role.

settings.title: Transparency
settings.text: Alchemia MD brings the same attentive care to its formulas that Dr. Luna brings to every patient. All ingredients are disclosed and each formula's purpose is explained in plain language.

settings.title: Multi-ingredient formulas
settings.text: Designed to reduce supplement overload and simplify daily use.

settings.title: Daily skin support
settings.text: Created for consistent use as part of a long-term skin health routine.

settings.heading: The science behind skin health from within.
settings.body: Dermatology does not end at the surface. Explore how nutrition, antioxidant pathways, the microbiome and cellular renewal contribute to skin health.

settings.heading: Formulation logic before ingredient hype.
settings.body: Every ingredient should serve a clear role in supporting skin health, resilience, balance, or recovery.

settings.heading: Skin is a living system.
settings.body: Skin is a living organ that renews itself continuously. What you eat, how you live and the environment you move through all shape how it looks and feels. Alchemia MD approaches skin health as a daily practice rather than a one-time effort.

settings.heading: Environmental stress.
settings.body: Sun, wind, travel and daily life place steady demands on skin. Topical care and sun protection remain essential. Internal nutritional support is one more layer of a thoughtful routine, never a replacement for sun protection.

settings.heading: Antioxidant support.
settings.body: Antioxidants are compounds that help neutralize free radicals, which the body produces naturally and which are also generated by environmental exposure. Several Alchemia MD ingredients, including vitamin C, EGCG, trans-resveratrol and astaxanthin, are valued for their antioxidant properties.

settings.heading: The gut-skin axis.
settings.body: Researchers study how the gut microbiome and the skin influence one another. Skinbiotic+ is a synbiotic, pairing a prebiotic fiber with probiotic strains, designed around that connection.

settings.heading: Immune balance.
settings.body: The immune system plays a role in how skin looks and feels. Dermaboost+ pairs nutrients that contribute to normal immune function, such as vitamin D and zinc, with antioxidants.

settings.heading: The ingredient library.
settings.body: Every ingredient and amount, exactly as it appears on the label.
